messages:
michelle-cs: Headline — AcmeCorp seeing duplicate role assignments and lingering admins after enabling Google Workspace SCIM sync. They say users appear twice in our console and deprovision takes 30–45m but roles remain. Can we triage?

raj-support: Thanks — can you paste a sample payload or org id and any error snippets? Is this happening for all groups or a specific one?

michelle-cs: Org: org_9a7b. Happens on 2 groups so far (engineering-all, infra-admins). From customer logs: when the connector rotated service token they saw a 403 on a PATCH: 

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.group.member"}
```
They said replays were retried and then both primary and alias addresses landed as separate members.

devon-eng: Quick hypothesis — Google push is sometimes emitting both primaryEmail and an alias login hint as separate member objects. Our SCIM mapper currently normalizes by `user.email` but doesn't canonicalize aliases or externalId prefixes, so the same account can get two distinct member entries (e.g., `alice@acme.com` and `alice+gsuite@acme.com`). When the token rotates during a brief 403, the connector retries and the dedupe step was skipped.

michelle-cs: sample SCIM patch from customer (redacted):

```
PATCH /Groups/01gr... HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-1234","display":"alice@acme.com"}]},
    {"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-1234-ali","display":"alice+gsuite@acme.com"}]}
  ]
}
```

devon-eng: That matches. Also seeing this in our provisioning logs: 

```
[2026-02-15T22:14:02Z] scim-connector: received patch for group 01gr..., members: 2
[2026-02-15T22:14:02Z] scim-connector: dedupe-step skipped (token-rotate-retry=true)
[2026-02-15T22:14:03Z] scim-connector: created role-binding role:infra-admin user:alice+gsuite@acme.com
[2026-02-15T22:14:05Z] scim-connector: created role-binding role:infra-admin user:alice@acme.com
```

devon-eng: When deprovision later runs it tries to remove by the canonical email we use (alice@acme.com) but the alias entry still points at `user-1234-ali` externalId so removal fails with `member not found`.

michelle-cs: Here's the customer-facing error when they click remove in the Console (from our backend):

```
2026-02-15T22:58:11Z ERROR role-service: remove_member failed group=01gr..., target=alice+gsuite@acme.com: user lookup by email returned 0 rows
```

scim-bot: Created ticket SCIM-9217 and incident INC-4129 for provisioning duplication. Assigned to devon-eng and ops-oncall.

alejandra-csm: Suggested workaround to customer while we fix: ask GSuite admin to remove alias from group (temporary), or disable live push and run a one-time canonical sync from our console (we have a "reconcile members" action). Also recommend enabling `normalize_externalid: true` on the connector (in the admin UI) — that will strip alias tokens/punctuation on ingest. I'll send the exact steps. :thumbsup:

raj-support: For engineering — can we add idempotent dedupe on ingest so duplicate display/email pairs are collapsed even across retries? Also need a reconciliation job to detect "orphaned" role-bindings where externalId != user.external_id and offer auto-fix.

devon-eng: Agreed. Plan:
- Short-term (today): ops-oncall will run a one-off reconciliation script that finds duplicates for org_9a7b and removes stale role-bindings. Script: `scripts/scim/reconcile_duplicates.py --org org_9a7b --dry-run` then run without `--dry-run`.
- Mid-term (next sprint): make dedupe step idempotent, canonicalize external_id with a configurable normalizer (pull domain aliases list from GSuite API), and add retry-safe token-rotate handling so dedupe isn't skipped.

ops-oncall: I'll schedule the one-off at 18:30 PT, will post run output here and the reconciliation job will emit summary metrics to #eng-sre. Rolling back is trivial (we keep audit entries and can reapply role-binding).

michelle-cs: I'll tell AcmeCorp the planned window and the temporary remediation steps. Please post the reconciliation run output here once complete.

raj-support: Thanks everyone. Logging follow-ups: SCIM-9217 (customer fix), SCIM-9230 (engineer work), and INC-4129 (ops run).

devon-eng: I'll open PR for canonicalizer and dedupe tests today: https://git.redwood/infra/SCIM-9230 — tagging @ops-oncall for deployment coordination.
